You start at IRS.gov/freefile.

If you start on a company's own home page, you are not in the IRS free offer.

For the season that filed 2025 returns, guided Free File software was for adjusted gross income of $89,000 or less.

Read the page for the season. Eight partners were listed for that 2026 season.

You use them if you are comfortable following the instructions yourself.

VITA and TCE are IRS-certified volunteers.

MilTax is the Defense Department tool for the military community.

If the payments are more than the tax, the difference is the refund.

If the payments are less, you pay the difference when you file.

A refund is your own money coming back.

Under the filing threshold, and tax was withheld: file if you want the withholding back.

books.title: How to not walk while using your phone
books.subject: Getting around

lines: How to not walk while using your phone

A short course on keeping your eyes up.

The phone can wait. The curb cannot.

If you need the phone, stop walking. Step out of the flow of people. Then look at the screen.

A message is not urgent because it arrived.

Walking is a job. Reading is a job. Do one.

Headphones make this worse. You lose the sound of a bike, a cart, or someone saying excuse me.

Not on stairs. Not at a crossing. Not on a platform edge.

If you are moving through a door, a station, or a crowd, the phone stays in your pocket.
You are at a crossing and a message arrives. What do you do?

Stop walking before you look. One job at a time. Stay off the phone on stairs, crossings, and platform edges.

That is the whole course.
